name: Feralas: a ghost released in Depthbreaker's Hollow reaches a Spirit Healer (#7648)
contract: A player who dies in Depthbreaker's Hollow (zone 10239, at the middle of its main cave (-4680.1,2433.1,-56.5)) releases at the nearest friendly graveyard of Feralas (357), graveyard 309 (-4596.4,3229.43,8.99376) for the Alliance, instead of the default Westfall graveyard. Its Spirit Healer 6491 stands near it. Death and spirit release use the native handlers.

steps.label: The released player is a ghost
The ghost lands at the Feralas graveyard
A Spirit Healer stands at the ghost's graveyard
